decision: Do not activate this full per-position pin-context/own-check shortcut under the frozen 8% objective. Preserve the safe opportunity result; reassess a materially cheaper or broader mechanism before another implementation.
limits: Call-count weighting and root legal-move microcosts approximate descendant CPU costs; this is not a rigorous ceiling or a measured whole-engine speed difference.
Gross proxy credits complete removal of later-reused status calls, although no such implementation exists; status/tag costs overlap and may be double credited.
Context estimate omits lookup/eligibility overhead but includes the tested full ray context; cheaper lazy contexts could differ.
Instrumented warm elapsed ratio is not cost evidence. All sampled data are inspected development controls; no game strength claim.
